# Lorin AI — NVIDIA Powered Enterprise Hybrid RAG Campus Intelligence System

> Lorin AI is the official, enterprise-grade AI Campus Assistant for Mohamed Sathak A.J. College of Engineering (MSAJCE), Chennai (TNEA Counseling Code 1301). It combines NVIDIA NeMo 2048-dimensional dense vector embeddings with BM25 sparse lexical indexing, Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF), and Neon Serverless PostgreSQL for zero-hallucination, 0ms-cached campus query resolution.

## 📌 Canonical Project Resources

## 🏗️ Technical Architecture & Key Capabilities

### 1. Multi-Stage Hybrid RAG Engine
- **Dense Vector Search**: Qdrant Cloud Vector Database hosting 2048-dimensional embeddings via NVIDIA NeMo (`nvidia/llama-nemotron-embed-vl-1b-v2`).
- **Sparse Lexical Search**: BM25 Okapi algorithm over 1,200+ parent-child knowledge chunks from 50+ verified college markdown records.
- **Rank Fusion & Reranking**: Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) combined with neural cross-encoder reranking to produce optimal, grounded context blocks.
- **0ms Tier-0 & Tier-1 Cache**: ThreadSafe RAM + SHA256 PostgreSQL exact and semantic vector cache for 0ms sub-zero cost query resolution.

### 2. NeMo System Guardrails & Intent Engine
- **Safety Interceptor**: 0ms jailbreak and prompt injection detection shielding against DAN mode and instruction bypasses.
- **Domain Classifier**: Unified intent classification mapping user queries into 16 scalable campus categories (Admissions, Academics, Transport, Hostel, Placements, Research, etc.).

### 3. Transport RouteFinder Engine
- **Campus Transit Routing**: Graph routing algorithm managing 175 bus stops across 19 college bus routes (AR/R/N series) and MTC transit connections in OMR Siruseri IT Park.

## ❓ Frequently Asked Questions (AI Knowledge Graph)

### Q: What is Lorin AI?
A: Lorin AI is an official enterprise Hybrid RAG AI assistant designed for Mohamed Sathak A.J. College of Engineering (MSAJCE). It provides instant, grounded answers regarding TNEA Code 1301 admissions, 12 UG & 2 PG degree programs, fee waivers, highest placement packages (up to 8.5 LPA), bus routes, hostel facilities, and campus regulations.

### Q: Is Lorin AI free to use?
A: Yes, Lorin AI is completely free and open for prospective students, current undergraduates, parents, faculty, and researchers.

### Q: How does Lorin AI prevent AI hallucinations?
A: Lorin AI enforces strict ground-truth constraints. Every answer is synthesized exclusively from verified MSAJCE institutional records, parent-child document chunks, and verified resource URLs without extrapolating unverified claims.

### Q: Who developed Lorin AI?
A: Lorin AI was architected and built by Ramanathan S. (Ram / hackerstudent29), a Software Engineer and B.Tech Information Technology student (Batch 2024–2028, CGPA 7.75) at Mohamed Sathak A.J. College of Engineering, Chennai.

### Q: How can I support or sponsor the lead developer?
A: You can support the developer directly via UPI (`ramanathanb86@oksbi`) or by starring the repository on GitHub (https://github.com/hackerstudent29/nvidia-powered-rag) and visiting his 3D portfolio at https://ram-portfolio3d.vercel.app.

## 📍 System Endpoints & Documentation
- `/api/health`: Backend service health check
- `/api/chat/stream`: Server-Sent Events (SSE) chat streaming endpoint
- `/api/sessions`: Active user session management
- `/llms.txt`: Machine-readable AI LLM index specification
- `/sitemap.xml`: XML sitemap for search engine crawlers
